custom_logic_notes: The X2MA indicator is a double-smoothed moving average: first smoothing with MA_Method1 (SMA, period 12, phase 15) applied to selected price, then second smoothing with MA_Method2 (JJMA, period 5, phase 15) applied to the first result. Entry logic: BUY when X2MA values show uptrend (Value[1]<Value[2] confirms prior decline) AND current bar rising (Value[0]>Value[1] confirms turnaround). SELL is the mirror. Signal is evaluated on bar[1] by default (SignalBar=1). The CXMA class from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh is used only for calculating min_rates_total (warmup period). TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose functions which wrap order sending with the MM money management parameter. GlobalVariableDel_ suggests global variable cleanup on deinit for trade state tracking.
python_conversion_notes: Must reimplement X2MA double-smoothing in Python. The JJMA (JMA) smoothing algorithm is non-trivial and requires careful porting from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh. The two-phase smoothing chain must be implemented: first apply SMA(12) to price, then apply JJMA(5) with phase=15 to the SMA result. Entry logic is straightforward once X2MA values are computed: compare current vs prior vs prior-prior values for crossover/turnaround detection. The TradeAlgorithms functions are simple market order wrappers with SL/TP and money management. Position sizing logic: if MM<0 use abs(MM) as fixed lot, if MM>0 use as deposit fraction.
